cache_iterator_basic: cache a data loader iterator with a fixed number of cached batches for benchmarking
cache_iterator_with_stop: cache an iterator and stop after a specified number of total iterations
cache_iterator_with_return_after: cache an iterator and return cached values after a specified number of source iterations
cache_iterator_no_delete: cache an iterator without deleting the source to preserve resources for reuse
cache_iterator_validation: validate that return_caches_after and stop_after parameters are greater than or equal to num_caches
